input.pr_title: feat: implement creator application flow with accept/reject/withdraw
input.pr_description:
Implements the creator application flow for the Creator Campaign Collaboration Platform.

## Changes
- New Application model with status machine (submitted → accepted/rejected/withdrawn)
- ApplicationRepository with CRUD + filtering by campaign/creator + search
- ApplicationService with business logic: submit, decide (accept/reject), withdraw
- Fit score calculation based on creator profile vs campaign requirements
- API endpoints: submit application, list campaign applications, list my applications, decide, withdraw
- Pydantic schemas: ApplicationCreate, ApplicationDecision, ApplicationResponse

## Follows existing patterns
- Repository pattern (CampaignRepository reference)
- Service layer with custom exceptions
- FastAPI router with deps injection

+from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
+
+from app.api.deps import CurrentUser, DBSession
+from app.repositories.application_repo import ApplicationRepository
+from app.repositories.campaign_repo import CampaignRepository
+from app.schemas.application import (
+    ApplicationCreate,
+    ApplicationDecision,
+    ApplicationResponse,
+)
+from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
+from app.services.application_service import ApplicationService
+
+router = APIRouter()
+
+
+def _get_service(db: DBSession) -> ApplicationService:
+    return ApplicationService(
+        ApplicationRepository(db),
+        CampaignRepository(db),
+    )
+
+
+@router.post(
+    "/campaigns/{campaign_id}/applications",
+    response_model=ApplicationResponse,
+    status_code=201,
+    tags=["applications"],
+)
+async def submit_application(
+    db: DBSession,
+    current_user: CurrentUser,
+    campaign_id: str,
+    data: ApplicationCreate,
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.submit_application(campaign_id, current_user, data)
+
+
+@router.get(
+    "/campaigns/{campaign_id}/applications",
+    response_model=PaginatedResponse[ApplicationResponse],
+    tags=["applications"],
+)
+async def list_campaign_applications(
+    db: DBSession,
+    current_user: CurrentUser,
+    campaign_id: str,
+    status: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.list_campaign_applications(
+        campaign_id, current_user, status=status, page=page, page_size=page_size
+    )
+
+
+@router.get(
+    "/applications/me",
+    response_model=PaginatedResponse[ApplicationResponse],
+    tags=["applications"],
+)
+async def list_my_applications(
+    db: DBSession,
+    current_user: CurrentUser,
+    status: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.list_my_applications(
+        current_user, status=status, page=page, page_size=page_size
+    )
+
+
+@router.patch(
+    "/applications/{application_id}",
+    response_model=ApplicationResponse,
+    tags=["applications"],
+)
+async def decide_application(
+    db: DBSession,
+    current_user: CurrentUser,
+    application_id: str,
+    data: ApplicationDecision,
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.decide_application(application_id, current_user, data)
+
+
+@router.delete(
+    "/applications/{application_id}",
+    status_code=204,
+    tags=["applications"],
+)
+async def withdraw_application(
+    db: DBSession,
+    current_user: CurrentUser,
+    application_id: str,
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.withdraw_application(application_id, current_user)

+import enum
+from datetime import date, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from sqlalchemy import (
+    Date,
+    DateTime,
+    Float,
+    ForeignKey,
+    Index,
+    Integer,
+    Numeric,
+    String,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
+
+from app.models.base import Base, SoftDeleteMixin, TimestampMixin, generate_uuid
+
+
+class ApplicationStatus(enum.Enum):
+    SUBMITTED = "submitted"
+    ACCEPTED = "accepted"
+    REJECTED = "rejected"
+    WITHDRAWN = "withdrawn"
+
+
+class Application(Base, TimestampMixin, SoftDeleteMixin):
+    __tablename__ = "applications"
+
+    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    campaign_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("campaigns.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    creator_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    status: Mapped[ApplicationStatus] = mapped_column(
+        nullable=False, default=ApplicationStatus.SUBMITTED
+    )
+    content_outline: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(1000), nullable=False)
+    estimated_delivery_date: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=False)
+    requested_fee: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(12, 2), nullable=False)
+    fit_score: Mapped[float | None] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=True)
+    rejection_reason: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(500), nullable=True)
+    responded_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
+        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
+    )
+    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
+
+    __table_args__ = (
+        Index("ix_applications_creator_id", "creator_id"),
+        Index("ix_applications_status", "status"),
+        Index("ix_applications_fit_score", "campaign_id", "fit_score"),
+    )
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"<Application {self.id[:8]} ({self.status.value})>"

@@ -0,0 +1,99 @@
+from sqlalchemy import func, select, text
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from app.models.application import Application, ApplicationStatus
+
+
+class ApplicationRepository:
+    def __init__(self, db: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.db = db
+
+    async def get_by_id(self, application_id: str) -> Application | None:
+        query = select(Application).where(
+            Application.id == application_id, Application.is_deleted.is_(False)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def get_active_by_creator_and_campaign(
+        self, creator_id: str, campaign_id: str
+    ) -> Application | None:
+        query = select(Application).where(
+            Application.creator_id == creator_id,
+            Application.campaign_id == campaign_id,
+            Application.status != ApplicationStatus.WITHDRAWN,
+            Application.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def list_by_campaign(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        status: ApplicationStatus | None = None,
+        search_term: str | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[Application], int]:
+        base = [
+            Application.campaign_id == campaign_id,
+            Application.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        ]
+        if status is not None:
+            base.append(Application.status == status)
+
+        count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(Application).where(*base)
+        total = (await self.db.execute(count_query)).scalar_one()
+
+        query = (
+            select(Application)
+            .where(*base)
+            .order_by(Application.fit_score.desc().nullslast())
+            .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
+            .limit(page_size)
+        )
+        if search_term:
+            query = query.where(text(f"content_outline LIKE '%{search_term}%'"))
+
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        applications = list(result.scalars().all())
+        return applications, total
+
+    async def list_by_creator(
+        self,
+        creator_id: str,
+        status: ApplicationStatus | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[Application], int]:
+        base = [
+            Application.creator_id == creator_id,
+            Application.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        ]
+        if status is not None:
+            base.append(Application.status == status)
+
+        count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(Application).where(*base)
+        total = (await self.db.execute(count_query)).scalar_one()
+
+        query = (
+            select(Application)
+            .where(*base)
+            .order_by(Application.created_at.desc())
+            .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
+            .limit(page_size)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        applications = list(result.scalars().all())
+        return applications, total
+
+    async def create(self, application: Application) -> Application:
+        self.db.add(application)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(application)
+        return application
+
+    async def update(self, application: Application) -> Application:
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(application)
+        return application

diff --git a/app/services/application_service.py b/app/services/application_service.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c7d8e9f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/services/application_service.py
@@ -0,0 +1,213 @@
+import math
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from app.models.application import Application, ApplicationStatus
+from app.models.campaign import Campaign, CampaignStatus
+from app.models.user import User, UserRole
+from app.repositories.application_repo import ApplicationRepository
+from app.repositories.campaign_repo import CampaignRepository
+from app.schemas.application import (
+    ApplicationCreate,
+    ApplicationDecision,
+    ApplicationResponse,
+)
+from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
+from app.utils.exceptions import ConflictError, ForbiddenError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
+
+
+def compute_fit_score(creator: User, campaign: Campaign) -> float:
+    category_score = 1.0
+    if campaign.required_categories:
+        creator_cats = set()
+        overlap = len(creator_cats & set(campaign.required_categories))
+        category_score = overlap / len(campaign.required_categories) if campaign.required_categories else 1.0
+
+    follower_score = 1.0
+    if campaign.min_follower_count and campaign.min_follower_count > 0:
+        follower_score = min(creator.follower_count / campaign.min_follower_count, 1.0)
+    if creator.follower_count == 0:
+        follower_score = 0.0
+
+    engagement_score = 1.0
+    if campaign.min_engagement_rate and campaign.min_engagement_rate > 0:
+        engagement_score = min(1.0, 1.0)
+
+    history_score = 0.5
+
+    fee_competitiveness = 1.0
+
+    return (
+        category_score * 0.4
+        + follower_score * 0.2
+        + engagement_score * 0.2
+        + history_score * 0.1
+        + fee_competitiveness * 0.1
+    )
+
+
+class ApplicationService:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        app_repo: ApplicationRepository,
+        campaign_repo: CampaignRepository,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.app_repo = app_repo
+        self.campaign_repo = campaign_repo
+
+    async def submit_application(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        creator: User,
+        data: ApplicationCreate,
+    ) -> ApplicationResponse:
+        if creator.role != UserRole.CREATOR:
+            raise ForbiddenError("Only creators can submit applications")
+
+        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(campaign_id)
+        if campaign is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", campaign_id)
+
+        if campaign.status != CampaignStatus.ACTIVE:
+            raise ValidationError("Campaign is not accepting applications")
+
+        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        if campaign.application_deadline <= now:
+            raise ValidationError("Application deadline has passed")
+
+        if data.requested_fee < campaign.min_fee or data.requested_fee > campaign.max_fee:
+            raise ValidationError(
+                f"Requested fee must be between {campaign.min_fee} and {campaign.max_fee}"
+            )
+
+        deadline_date = campaign.content_deadline.date() if hasattr(campaign.content_deadline, 'date') else campaign.content_deadline
+        if data.estimated_delivery_date >= deadline_date:
+            raise ValidationError(
+                "Estimated delivery date must be before campaign content deadline"
+            )
+
+        # TODO: add locking to prevent duplicate applications under concurrent requests
+        existing = await self.app_repo.get_active_by_creator_and_campaign(
+            creator.id, campaign_id
+        )
+        if existing is not None:
+            raise ConflictError("Application", "campaign", campaign_id)
+
+        fit_score = compute_fit_score(creator, campaign)
+
+        application = Application(
+            campaign_id=campaign_id,
+            creator_id=creator.id,
+            status=ApplicationStatus.SUBMITTED,
+            content_outline=data.content_outline,
+            estimated_delivery_date=data.estimated_delivery_date,
+            requested_fee=data.requested_fee,
+            fit_score=fit_score,
+        )
+        application = await self.app_repo.create(application)
+        return ApplicationResponse.model_validate(application)
+
+    async def list_campaign_applications(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        brand_user: User,
+        status: str | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[ApplicationResponse]:
+        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(campaign_id)
+        if campaign is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", campaign_id)
+        if campaign.brand_id != brand_user.id:
+            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this campaign")
+
+        status_enum = ApplicationStatus(status) if status else None
+        applications, total = await self.app_repo.list_by_campaign(
+            campaign_id=campaign_id, status=status_enum, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[ApplicationResponse](
+            items=[ApplicationResponse.model_validate(a) for a in applications],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )
+
+    async def list_my_applications(
+        self,
+        creator: User,
+        status: str | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[ApplicationResponse]:
+        status_enum = ApplicationStatus(status) if status else None
+        applications, total = await self.app_repo.list_by_creator(
+            creator_id=creator.id, status=status_enum, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[ApplicationResponse](
+            items=[ApplicationResponse.model_validate(a) for a in applications],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )
+
+    async def decide_application(
+        self,
+        application_id: str,
+        brand_user: User,
+        data: ApplicationDecision,
+    ) -> ApplicationResponse:
+        application = await self.app_repo.get_by_id(application_id)
+        if application is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Application", application_id)
+
+        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(application.campaign_id)
+        if campaign is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", application.campaign_id)
+        if campaign.brand_id != brand_user.id:
+            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this campaign")
+
+        if application.status != ApplicationStatus.SUBMITTED:
+            raise ValidationError(
+                f"Cannot {data.action} application in '{application.status.value}' status"
+            )
+
+        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+
+        if data.action == "accept":
+            if campaign.remaining_budget < application.requested_fee:
+                raise ConflictError("Campaign", "budget", "insufficient")
+            campaign.remaining_budget -= application.requested_fee
+            await self.campaign_repo.update(campaign)
+
+            application.status = ApplicationStatus.ACCEPTED
+            application.responded_at = now
+
+        elif data.action == "reject":
+            application.status = ApplicationStatus.REJECTED
+            application.rejection_reason = data.rejection_reason
+            application.responded_at = now
+
+        application.version += 1
+        application = await self.app_repo.update(application)
+        return ApplicationResponse.model_validate(application)
+
+    async def withdraw_application(
+        self,
+        application_id: str,
+        creator: User,
+    ) -> None:
+        application = await self.app_repo.get_by_id(application_id)
+        if application is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Application", application_id)
+        if application.creator_id != creator.id:
+            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this application")
+        if application.status != ApplicationStatus.SUBMITTED:
+            raise ValidationError(
+                "Can only withdraw applications in 'submitted' status"
+            )
+
+        application.status = ApplicationStatus.WITHDRAWN
+        application.version += 1
+        await self.app_repo.update(application)

planted_defects.title: SQL injection via unsanitized search_term in text() query
planted_defects.description: The list_by_campaign method accepts a search_term parameter and constructs a raw SQL fragment using f-string interpolation: `text(f"content_outline LIKE '%{search_term}%'")`. An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL by providing a malicious search_term value such as `%'; DROP TABLE applications; --`. This is a classic SQL injection vulnerability (CWE-89, OWASP A03:2021).
planted_defects.root_cause: The search_term user input is interpolated directly into a SQL string via f-string formatting instead of using parameterized queries. SQLAlchemy's `text()` with `bindparams()` or column-level `.contains()` / `.like()` methods should be used instead.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Use parameterized query: `query = query.where(Application.content_outline.contains(search_term))` or `query = query.where(text("content_outline LIKE :term").bindparams(term=f'%{search_term}%'))`

planted_defects.title: Race condition: duplicate application check is not atomic (TOCTOU)
planted_defects.description: The submit_application method performs a check-then-act pattern: it first queries for an existing active application, then creates a new one if none is found. Under concurrent requests, two simultaneous submissions from the same creator for the same campaign can both pass the duplicate check and both create applications, violating the business rule that only one active application per creator per campaign is allowed. The TODO comment acknowledges the issue but no fix is in place.
planted_defects.root_cause: The get_active_by_creator_and_campaign check and the subsequent create operation are not wrapped in a transaction with a SELECT ... FOR UPDATE lock or enforced via a database-level unique constraint. This is a Time-of-Check-to-Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition.

expected_location.line_hint: # TODO: add locking to prevent duplicate applications

planted_defects.suggested_fix: Either add a unique database constraint on (campaign_id, creator_id) with a partial index excluding withdrawn applications, or use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE in the duplicate check query to serialize concurrent access.

planted_defects.title: Missing standalone index on campaign_id for application lookups
planted_defects.description: The Application model defines indexes on creator_id, status, and a composite (campaign_id, fit_score), but lacks a standalone index on campaign_id. The list_by_campaign repository method filters by campaign_id as its primary predicate, but without a dedicated index, the database must either scan the full table or rely on the composite index which is less efficient for queries that don't also filter/sort by fit_score. This leads to degraded query performance as the applications table grows.
planted_defects.root_cause: The `Index('ix_applications_campaign_id', 'campaign_id')` entry is missing from __table_args__. While a composite index on (campaign_id, fit_score) exists, it cannot serve queries that only filter by campaign_id as efficiently as a dedicated single-column index.
